Class SSLContext

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.javax.net.ssl.SSLContext
public final class SSLContext extends Object
The board-side javax.net.ssl.SSLContext: the trust a java.net.http client checks servers against, given with HttpClient.newBuilder().sslContext(context). It carries only trust anchors: the board's TLS client does the handshake, so the protocol name is kept but not enforced, and client certificates are not supported. Trust anchors take effect on the boards that can change them at runtime, the ESP32 boards and the Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W; elsewhere a request through a client with an SSLContext fails with an IOException.
